atoms.b: There are over 8 million different animal species on Earth. However, researchers believe that there are ((++even_more no_more)) to be discovered. Animals belong to the same species if they are capable of having ((++offspring food)) together.
Around half of all animal species on Earth, such as the ((++leopard cow)), are threatened by extinction.
Since there are so many types of animals, we divide the animals into different classes. The most well-known classes are ((++mammals pets)), birds, fish, insects, reptiles and amphibians.
((++Mammals Reptiles)) breastfeed their offspring and have spines.
((Fish ++Birds)) lay eggs and have feathers. Most of them can fly.
((++Fish Birds)) live and breathe underwater and move around with their fins.
((++Insects Amphibians)) have a shell, six legs and often two or four wings as well.
((++Reptiles Mammals)) have scaly skin and move around by crawling.
((++Amphibians Insects)) have wet skin and can live on land or in water.
